posts.title: Glimpses of today (20261123)
posts.description: Am starting to suspect that a neighbor got ducks. Never used to hear any quacking, but then a few weeks ago that changed. There's a tiny stream a few streets over but otherwise no water in the immediate area, and the sound always comes from the same direction. No idea whether this is a pets or meat (or eggs) situation. But am deeply glad there's no rooster. Made a batch of bar cookies today. Vanil

posts.title: A note on crashes
posts.description: Occasionally, for no reason i can identify, my system just crashes--energy, cramps/pain, brain fog. There's definitely a gut and/or vagal nerve component, and my old neurologist suspected it was tied to the migraines but there isn't a way to know for sure. It's frustrating and annoying.
